OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
## 🚀 KuCoin PROOF: Tis the Season (550,000 USDT Prize Pool)
Celebrate Black Friday and the festive season with the KuCoin PROOF: Tis the Season Futures Contest! Compete across three action-packed challenges plus bonus perks to claim your share of 550,000 USDT.
## 🏆 Track 1: Solo Volume Leaderboard (150,000 USDT Pool)
Top Rank Pool (120,000 USDT): The Top 200 traders by Futures volume share 120,000 USDT in cash and Futures Points—plus extra Grand Lucky Draw entries to win a Tomorrowland Winter package, event tickets, and End-of-Year KuCoin gift bags.
Sunshine Pool (30,000 USDT): Qualified non-ranking participants split a 30,000 USDT reward pool!
## 📈 Track 2: PnL TraderPro Challenge (100,000 USDT Pool)
1,000 USDT Trial Funds: Open to everyone! Register to receive 1,000 USDT in Lead Trading Trial Funds and earn from both your own trading profits and follower profit-sharing.
Dynamic Prize Pool: Reach ≥ 20,000 USDT in eligible trading volume and finish with a positive PnL to qualify. The Top 100 Lead Traders by PnL share the unlocked 100,000 USDT pool.
## 🎡 Track 3: Daily Spin Wheel — 100% Guaranteed Wins (200,000 USDT Pool)
100% Win Rate: Spin daily for 0.1 BTC, 1 ETH, 1,000 XRP, cash vouchers, Tomorrowland Winter packages,tickets, and End-of-Year KuCoin gift bags.
1-in-3 Instant Cash: Enjoy a 30% chance to land instant cash starting from 1 USDT.
Easy Unlocks: Complete daily missions starting at 800 USDT in volume to earn spins.
## 🎁 Extra Festive Perks: New User & Referral Bonuses (100,000+ USDT Pool)
New User Bonus (100,000 USDT Pool): Sign up and trade to get a 100 USDT Futures Airdrop Position Voucher (first 1,000 new users, first-come, first-served).
Referral Airdrop (10,000 USDT Pool): Invite a new user to register, enroll in the challenge, and achieve ≥ 100 USDT in eligible Futures trading volume each to receive a 50 USDT Futures Airdrop Position. Referrers may claim up to 3 times and invitees once.
35% Super Commission: Eligible participants can unlock an upgraded 35% referral commission rate.
## 💡 Track Your Progress
Earn Futures Points on the Solo Leaderboard to redeem for Position Airdrops, Fee Vouchers,or Quarterly Cash—all on the Futures Arena Dashboard!
## 📅 Event Timeline (UTC+8)
From 12:00 on November 16, 2026 to 00:00 on December 1, 2026 (UTC+8)
## Ready to celebrate and trade your way to the top?
Notes
Rewards are subject to eligibility and distribution rules.
Futures trading involves risk and may result in losses. Please trade responsibly.
Apple is not a sponsor and is not involved in this activity in any manner.
KuCoin reserves the right of final interpretation of this campaign.

Exchange/platform: Bitfinex
Headline: Bitfinex zero trading fees: 0% maker and 0% taker on spot, margin and derivatives — for every user
Start: 2026-11-16T00:00:00Z · End: 2026-11-30T23:59:00Z
Note: the rules text below may be incomplete (only the announcement preview was available).
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Bitfinex charges 0% maker and 0% taker fees on spot and margin trading, on Bitfinex Derivatives, on eligible products of Bitfinex Securities and on OTC block trades.
All Bitfinex customers are eligible: no trading-volume requirement, no LEO token holdings and no fee tier to reach. Bitfinex calls it the new default, not a time-limited promotion.
Not covered: lending fees, withdrawal fees and other non-trading charges stay as before. Thalex derivatives are not on the zero-fee list.
No end date is announced — Bitfinex can change its fee schedule at any time. Check the fee page before trading.
Zero fees do not remove other trading costs: the spread and slippage on thin order books still apply.

Exchange/platform: Lighter
Headline: Lighter zero fees: 0% maker and 0% taker on perps and spot for Standard accounts
Start: 2026-11-16T00:00:00Z · End: 2026-11-30T23:59:00Z
Note: the rules text below may be incomplete (only the announcement preview was available).
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Standard accounts (the default account type) pay no maker or taker fees on regular perpetual and spot orders.
TWAP/advanced orders and RFQ on Standard accounts cost 1 bp (0.01%).
The price of zero fees is speed: on Standard accounts taker orders and cancels/modifications wait 300 ms; maker orders have no delay.
Premium/Advanced accounts are opt-in and pay fees (0.004% maker / 0.028% taker without LIT staking; up to 30% off when staking LIT) in exchange for lower latency.
Zero fees do not remove other trading costs: the spread, slippage and funding on perpetuals still apply. Lighter can change its fee model at any time — check the fee page before trading.

Exchange/platform: Paradex
Headline: Paradex zero fees for retail: 0% maker and 0% taker on perps, spot and options
Start: 2026-11-16T00:00:00Z · End: 2026-11-30T23:59:00Z
Note: the rules text below may be incomplete (only the announcement preview was available).
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Retail orders on Paradex pay 0% maker and 0% taker fees on perpetuals, spot and options.
An order counts as Retail when it is placed through the Paradex web app (or via API with an interactive token). Regular API orders are Pro orders and pay Pro fees (0.003% maker, taker from 0.045%).
Retail orders have a 300 ms speed bump on submission and cancellation and are limited to 3 orders per second, 30 per minute, 300 per hour and 1,000 per 24 hours.
If an account exceeds the Retail rate limits it is switched to Pro behaviour and loses the zero-fee retail treatment.
Zero fees do not remove other trading costs: the spread, slippage and funding on perpetuals still apply. Paradex can change its fees at any time — check the fee page before trading.

Exchange/platform: OKX
Headline: OKX zero-fee spot pairs: 0% maker and taker on USDC-USDT and PYUSD-USDT
Start: 2026-11-16T00:00:00Z · End: 2026-11-30T23:59:00Z
Note: the rules text below may be incomplete (only the announcement preview was available).
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
OKX keeps zero maker and zero taker fees on selected stablecoin spot pairs: USDC-USDT and PYUSD-USDT (its notice of December 24, 2025 also lists DAI-USDT and USDG-USDT).
The zero-fee promotion on USDT-USD stablecoin pairs ended on January 7, 2026 — standard spot fees apply there.
Zero-fee pairs may not be available in every jurisdiction, and rates differ by region: log in and check the Trading Fees page for your account.
Volume on zero-fee pairs usually does not count toward VIP tiers or trading competitions.
Useful for moving between stablecoins for free; it is not a discount on trading other coins.

Exchange/platform: Binance
Headline: Africa Mobile Money Buy Crypto: Unlock a 20% Bonus Tiered APR on USDC Simple Earn Flexible
Start: 2026-11-16T00:00:00Z · End: 2027-01-03T23:59:00Z
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Fellow Binancians,
Binance is launching a two-phase campaign for eligible users in select African markets. Users who buy crypto through mobile money channels and reach a cumulative purchase amount of 100 USD equivalent or more with your local currency (KES, XAF, XOF, UGX, SLE, ZMW, RWF, CDF) during the Campaign Periods will be able to enjoy a 7-day 20% Bonus Tiered APR on USDC Simple Earn Flexible Products, capped at 500 USDC.
Buy Crypto with MoMo Now
## Campaign Period and Bonus APR Schedule
Phase 1 (Black Friday)
Campaign Period: 2026-11-16 to 2026-11-29
Bonus APR issue date: 2026-11-30
Bonus APR effective date: 2026-12-01
Bonus APR duration: 7 days
Phase 2 (Christmas and New Year)
Campaign Period: 2026-12-21 to 2027-01-03
Bonus APR issue date: 2027-01-04
Bonus APR effective date: 2027-01-05
## Eligibility
This campaign is available to eligible retail users only (institutional accounts and sub-accounts are not eligible). Users must be 18+, have completed identity verification (KYC), and have an account in good standing.
Eligible markets (based on KYC country/region): Benin, Burkina Faso, Cameroon, Côte d'Ivoire, DRC (Democratic Republic of Congo), Gabon, Kenya, Mali, Republic of Congo, Rwanda, Senegal, Sierra Leone, Tanzania, Togo, and Uganda
## How to Participate
Buy crypto via mobile money fiat on-ramp during the Campaign Periods.
Reach a cumulative 100 USD equivalent or above with your local currency in successful Buy Crypto orders during the Campaign Periods.
The cumulative amount is calculated in USD equivalent, using Binance’s exchange rate at the time of each transaction.
## Reward Structure
Eligible users will be able to view and subscribe to the special offer starting from the Bonus APR effective date stated above.
Subscription Format: first-come, first-served basis in accordance with the terms below.
## Reward Payout:
Bonus Tiered APR: Distributed to users’ Spot Accounts on a daily basis. The first reward will be given the day after accrual starts (two days after subscription).
Real-Time APR: Accrued and directly accumulated in users’ Earn Accounts every minute.
Digital Asset | Duration | APR During the Campaign Period | Campaign Period | Min. Subscription Limit per User | Max. Subscription Limit per User
USDC | Flexible | Tier 1 | Tier 2 | Please see effective date stated above | 0.1 USDC | 300 Million USDC
Real-Time APR + 20% Bonus Tiered APR (0 - 500 USDC) | Real-Time APR (Tier > 500 USDC)
## Example
Suppose User A holds 1,000 USDC in Simple Earn Flexible Products and completes the task.
 | USDC Bonus Tiered APR (20%) | USDC Real-Time APR (around 3.27%) | 7-Day Earnings
Regular Subscription Reward | N/A | 1,000 | ≈ 0.62 USDC
Bonus APR Reward During the Campaign Periods | 500 | 500 | ≈ 2.23 USDC
## Important Notes
Only mobile money fiat on-ramp Buy Crypto orders count. P2P order does not count.
Orders must be successfully credited and settled to qualify. Failed, pending, canceled, reversed, refunded, or chargeback orders do not count.
Binance may disqualify users or transactions that are suspected to involve abusive behavior or risk activity, including fraud-related activity, self-transfer patterns, gambling-related merchant activity, cash-out flows, or attempts to manipulate the campaign rules.
## How to Get Started with USDC Flexible Products
Users can buy USDC on the Buy Crypto page, which supports local and international payment methods
Head to [Simple Earn], and search for USDC.
Select FLEXIBLE, and subscribe to USDC Simple Earn Flexible Products to start earning exclusive APR Rewards.
## For More Information
How to Buy Crypto with KES, XOF, XAF, ZMW, USD, SLE, GHS, UGX, TZS, CDF on Binance
How to Sell Crypto with KES, XOF, XAF, ZMW, USD, SLE, GHS, UGX, TZS, CDF on Binance
How Simple Earn Works
## Terms & Conditions
Only users who complete identity verification during the Promotion Period can qualify for rewards in the Promotion, and only master accounts qualify for rewards in the Promotion. Sub-accounts are not eligible to receive rewards.
The products or features referred to above may not be available in users’ regions. Users are responsible for informing themselves about and observing any restrictions and/or requirements imposed with respect to the access to and use of Binance services in each country from which the services are accessed.
Changes to the Binance Simple Earn Rewards Rate will be published on the Platform from time to time. Please refer to Binance Simple Earn Terms & Conditions and Risk Warning for more information prior to using Binance Simple Earn.
## Rewards:
Real-Time APR is subject to change every minute, please refer to the respective product page(s) for accurate information. Real-Time APR rewards are accrued and directly accumulated in users’ Earn Accounts every minute.
Bonus Tiered APR is offered as an additional reward on top of Real-Time APR. Upon subscription, Bonus Tiered APR rewards start to accrue the next day starting from 00:00 (UTC) based on the snapshot of your subscribed amounts to the Flexible Product of the day, which will be taken randomly between 00:00:00 to 23:59:59 (UTC) daily. Rewards will start to be distributed the following day after accrual starts between 00:00 (UTC) and 08:00 (UTC) to the user’s Spot Account.
Any redemption of Flexible Products made between 00:00:00 (UTC) and 00:00:00 (UTC) of the following day will stop the accrual of Bonus Tiered APR rewards on the redeemed amount for that day.
Redemptions of Flexible Products will be processed starting with assets that have accrued rewards. Users can check the rewards history from the Earn History.
Bonus Tiered APR rewards are calculated based on the subscribed amounts and are subject to the respective tier limit for each token. Please refer to the FAQ for more details.
All users who hold open positions for USDC Flexible Products will receive both Real-Time APR and Bonus Tiered APR rewards during the Promotion Period. Once the Promotion ends, users will be entitled to Real-Time APR rewards only.
APR rewards are distributed from Binance’s own funds, and are determined based on the assessment and evaluation of prevailing market conditions.
The Activity's subscription amount of each user has an upper limit. When the upper limit is reached, users will no longer be able to subscribe.
A large amount of redemption requests might delay redemption temporarily. Redemptions may resume upon return of liquidity.
Users can view their Flexible Products assets by going to Assets > Earn > Simple Earn.
Redemption time for Flexible Products subscriptions: Instant.
There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise.
